t: This is the Empire Cinema in Islington, a former theatre that now shows films. The theatre was designed by Frank Matcham, an English architect who specialised in theatres and music halls. During a forty-year career he designed over ninety theatres and reworked about eighty others. Much of his London work was for Moss Empires, including the Hippodrome, Hackney Empire, Shepherd's Bush Empire, the Coliseum and the Palladium. So the building you are looking at comes from the same hand as some of London's best-loved auditoriums.
